content: Transcriptional-regulating factor 1 (TRERF1) is a protein in humans that is encoded by the TRERF1 gene. This gene produces a zinc-finger transcriptional-regulating protein, which interacts with CBP/p300 to regulate the expression of the human gene CYP11A1. TRERF1 has been demonstrated to interact with several key proteins, including Steroidogenic Factor 1, EP300, and CREB-binding protein.
